name: Svc_AcClient_Close
summary: Performs synchronous shutdown of the AC (Auto-Connect) network session: creates a temporary event handle, calls Svc_AcClient_CloseAsync, waits for completion via svcWaitSynchronization1, and retrieves the final close status.
evidence: 3dbrew documents AC (ac:u/ac:i) handle *0x007AF090 IPC command 0x0008 (header 0x00080004) as CloseAsync and 0x0009 (header 0x00090002) as GetCloseResult. This function creates an event with Os_CreateEventHandle (0x00509C6C), initiates CloseAsync, waits on the event via svc 0x24 (svcWaitSynchronization1), closes the event via svc 0x23, and queries GetCloseResult.

name: Svc_AcClient_CloseAsync
summary: Issues asynchronous AC session close command 0x00080004 with a completion event handle to the AC service.
evidence: Sends IPC command 0x00080004 on AC service handle *0x007AF090 with eventHandle. 3dbrew documents AC command 0x0008 as CloseAsync(Handle event).

name: Svc_AcClient_GetCloseResult
summary: Queries the result of an asynchronous AC session close request via IPC command 0x00090002.
evidence: Sends parameterless IPC command 0x00090002 on AC service handle *0x007AF090. 3dbrew documents AC command 0x0009 as GetCloseResult().

name: Fs_DeleteFile
signature: unsigned int Fs_DeleteFile(const unsigned short* path)
summary: Deletes a file by wide-character path: parses the archive mount prefix, builds an FS_Path descriptor of type PATH_UTF16, and invokes archive vtable method 2 (DeleteFile).
evidence: Disassembly shows Ghidra truncated at blx wcslen (0x00100B74 mis-marked noreturn per FACTS.md). The function splits the mount prefix before ':', constructs a 3DS FS_Path struct (type 4, pointer, byte size (wcslen+1)*2), and dispatches to archive vtable slot 2 [r0, #8] (FSUSER_DeleteFile). Called by Save_BuildSlotFilePaths (0x002CD6F4).

name: Gfx_Lighting_BuildLutDeltas
signature: void Gfx_Lighting_BuildLutDeltas(u32 self, u32 channelShift, float* values, u32 forwarded)
summary: Constructs 256 consecutive difference/derivative samples from a floating-point table and passes them to Gfx_VertexStream_WriteQuantizedColors to configure PICA200 lighting lookup tables.
evidence: Callee Gfx_VertexStream_WriteQuantizedColors (0x0050857C) writes PICA200 GPU registers 0x00AF (GPUREG_LIGHTING_LUT_INDEX) and 0x00B0 (GPUREG_LIGHTING_LUT_DATA). PICA200 hardware encodes 256-sample lighting LUTs as difference/slope deltas between successive samples (values[i+1] - values[i]). Called by Gfx_MaterialState_WriteConstants (0x00659C24).

name: Mem_ExpHeap_Create
signature: int Mem_ExpHeap_Create(int self, u32 offset, int size)
summary: Initializes an nn::fnd::ExpHeap (Expanded Heap): verifies buffer 4-byte alignment, registers the heap range with magic 0x45585048 ('EXPH'), formats initial free block header with tag 0x4652 ('FR'), and sets up free list pointers.
evidence: Corresponds to Nintendo CTR SDK nn::fnd::ExpHeap::Create: registers heap with FourCC 0x45585048 ('EXPH'), formats initial free block with magic 0x4652 ('FR' for free block), computes available size, and initializes free block list heads.

name: Mem_ExpHeap_FindBlock
summary: Traverses ExpHeap memory block range tree rooted at node to locate the block descriptor encompassing the specified address.
evidence: Core block search routine of nn::fnd::ExpHeap: recursively descends block range nodes comparing address against block boundary [f_18, f_1c); called by Mem_ExpHeap_UnlinkBlock and Mem_ExpHeap_InsertBlock.

name: Mem_ExpHeap_UnlinkBlock
summary: Finds the ExpHeap memory block for address and unlinks it from the doubly-linked free list rooted at 0x007F25C0, decrementing the free block counter.
evidence: Part of nn::fnd::ExpHeap memory allocation: locates block via Mem_ExpHeap_FindBlock, unlinks previous and next list pointers, zeroes linkage, and decrements free block count.

name: Mem_ExpHeap_InsertBlock
signature: void Mem_ExpHeap_InsertBlock(u32* node, u32 tag, u32 stored, u32 stored2, u32 byteFlag)
summary: Inserts a newly formatted or freed memory block into the ExpHeap block list rooted at 0x007F25C0, updating doubly-linked list pointers and incrementing the block counter.
evidence: nn::fnd::ExpHeap block insertion routine: sets block header tag and attributes, locates insertion point via Mem_ExpHeap_FindBlock in registry at 0x007F25C0, splices into list, and increments block count.
